Integrating f'= (K/2-σ)f-(K/2)f^3 gives the claimed below, above and critical flows. Strict monotonicity proves positive covariance except the synchronized fixed trajectory. Dominated exponential asymptotics yield both offcritical coefficients. At criticality f(s)=[K(s+θ)]^{-1/2}; first Taylor term is age-independent and cancels in covariance, so C(t)=μ'(λ)/(2√K)e^{-λt}t^{-3/2}(1+O(t^{-1})), μ'=-Cov(f(A),A)>0. Laplace age covariance kernel λuv/[(λ+u+v)(λ+u)(λ+v)] and Tonelli independently yield nonnegative ρ(v), with √v edge. Numerical independent age quadrature ratios at lags 50,100,300 were 0.93979,0.96895,0.98943 against sharp asymptotic; the infinite conclusion rests on proof, not quadrature.
